description: This dataset contains knee X-ray data for both knee joint detection and knee KL grading. The dataset is organized from OAI (https://oai.epi-ucsf.org/datarelease/).
reference_paper: Chen, P., Gao, L., Shi, X., Allen, K., & Yang, L. (2019). Fully automatic knee osteoarthritis severity grading using deep neural networks with a novel ordinal loss. Computerized Medical Imaging and Graphics, 75, 84-92. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.compmedimag.2019.06.002

Note that further permission may be required for any content within the dataset that is identified as belonging to a third party.

usage_limitations: Published on Mendeley Data under CC BY 4.0 with attribution to Pingjun Chen.
Images originate from the Osteoarthritis Initiative (OAI); Mendeley's CC BY 4.0 notice explicitly states that further permission may be required for third-party content.
Raw X-ray images are NOT committed to GitHub to respect repository size limits and third-party medical data redistribution practices.
auto_test (1,526 YOLO-cropped test images) is excluded from manifest/split because it contains the same test subjects as the official test set.

selected_subset.selection_rationale: kneeKL224 is the primary default dataset in Pingjun Chen's official ClsKL training code (train_kl.py) and standard benchmark literature. It contains 8,260 bilateral knee X-ray crops from 4,130 OAI baseline subjects partitioned by patient into train (5,778; 69.95%), val (826; 10.00%), and test (1,656; 20.05%). auto_test (1,526 images) is excluded because it consists of automatically detected crops of the exact same test subjects.
